evidence.title: Dock layout system (panels, split views, tabs)

name: GPUI Kit
summary: Rust desktop UI framework: 75+ components and primitives on GPUI, with data tables, a code editor, charts and dock layout.
description: GPUI Kit builds cross-platform desktop apps in Rust on GPUI, Zed's UI framework. It ships styled components, an unstyled behavior layer (gpui-base) and an optional JavaScript extension runtime (gpui-shell), plus WebAssembly support, AccessKit accessibility, UI integration testing and a story gallery. Extracted from Longbridge Pro, a shipped commercial desktop app.
contains: three layers: gpui-component (styled), gpui-base (behavior), gpui-shell (JS extension runtime)
data tables with virtual scrolling and resizable columns; code editor stable at 200K lines
dock layout: resizable panels, draggable tabs, nested splits, serializable
macOS, Windows and Linux from one codebase; WebAssembly support
AccessKit accessibility and headless UI integration tests
story gallery app showcases every component; skills for AI coding agents
software and doc code examples Apache-2.0; doc prose CC BY 4.0
